subject: Pricing + IO definitions, EU residency & commitment tiers
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@luminahealth.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Quick ask: per-1M IO rates + model roster (EU residency concern)

Hi Rafael,

We're evaluating Redwood for a pilot that will run in the EU region (data residency required). Before our procurement kickoff, two quick asks so we can model costs and confirm compliance: 1) a baseline hosted API per-1M token price split by input vs output for the models you support (we care about both small/fast and higher-quality variants), and 2) confirmation that hosted API logs & payloads for EU-region endpoints are processed and stored within EU data centers (any SOC2 / data residency notes are helpful).

Also: our finance team will likely ask about committed monthly volume discounts and whether prepay credits or monthly commit tiers are available for hosted. If you could outline standard tiers (1M / 10M / 50M / 200M) and the typical % discount off list at each tier that'd be perfect.

I'll attach the MAAP/security checklist for context in case that helps align responses. Looking forward to a short sheet we can share internally.

Thanks,
Maria Santos
Dir. Product, Lumina Health
Attachments: Lumina_MAAP_checklist.xlsx
From: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@luminahealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: 2028-07-18T11:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M IO rates + model roster (EU residency concern)

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear note and for the MAAP. Looping in Monica from our pricing & partnerships team to confirm the official ratecard and residency language. Quick answers inline below to unblock your modeling: 

- IO definition: we bill input tokens (text you send) and output tokens (generated text) separately; most customers use the combined per-1M token math in their cost models but we provide an IO split on invoices.

- Baseline hosted (list) — per 1,000,000 tokens (rounded):
  * rw-alpha-3B (fast / low-cost): input $5, output $8
  * rw-instruct-7B (balanced): input $9, output $14
  * rw-alpha-13B (high-quality): input $22, output $34
  * rw-chat-xl (conversational/high-context): input $30, output $50

Note: These are example baseline list rates for hosted endpoints in the EU region; we can provide a PDF ratecard and a CSV export for your internal modeling.

- Commitment / discounts: standard hosted commit program options (monthly commit):
  * 0–1M tokens: list pricing
  * 1M–10M tokens/month: typically 8–12% off list
  * 10M–50M tokens/month: 12–20% off list
  * 50M–200M tokens/month: 20–30% off list
  * 200M+ tokens/month: custom enterprise pricing + potential Dedicated offering conversation

We also offer prepay credits (1–12 month expiry options) and annual committed spend paths that increase discount bands. I'll ask Monica to attach the formal PDF and confirm whether any of these tiers have minimum seat/contract language for EU customers.

I'll follow up with a formal PDF and a short summary (single page) that you can circulate. Are you available for a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement and product through the numbers?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@luminahealth.com>, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: 2028-07-19T08:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M IO rates + model roster (EU residency concern)

Hi Maria — Monica here. Attaching the Q3 ratecard and a short EU residency note. Highlights:

- EU residency: Our hosted EU endpoints are served from EU regions (Frankfurt / Dublin), and logs/telemetry tied to EU-region endpoints are stored in-region by default. We support customer-managed KMS and can provide a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with EU-specific clauses. SOC 2 is available; we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA.

- Rates & tiers: The table Rafael provided are list examples; attached PDF includes exact per-1M IO line items and currency options (EUR / USD).

- Commit mechanics: discounts are applied as a percentage off list for committed monthly volumes. Prepay credit gives additional 3–5% uplift on top of commit discounts depending on the prepay window. Commits are typically 12-month contracts but we do offer shorter pilots (3 months) with slightly reduced discounts.

Attachments: Redwood_Hosted_RateCard_Q3_2028.pdf

If helpful, I can prepare two scenarios (pilot: 5M tokens/mo for 3 months vs production ramp: 50M tokens/mo for 12 months) and show the net monthly spend and effective $/1k tokens after discounts and prepay. Would you prefer EUR pricing for the sheet?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Pricing & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@luminahealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: 2028-07-20T14:38:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M IO rates + model roster (EU residency concern)

Thanks Rafael / Monica — that's super helpful. Yes please to EUR pricing and the two scenario sheets (pilot vs ramp). Procurement would also like to confirm: 1) whether unused committed tokens roll over month-to-month, and 2) billing cadence for prepay credits (monthly vs upfront). We prefer rollovers where possible.

Let's take the 20-minute call on Monday 07/22 at 10:00 CET if that works for you — I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Maria
